_comment: Shape classes for `ros2 run polyumi_ros2 texture_collect`, in collection order.
One object per class, because the class IS the object here. 'empty' means exactly that:
close the jaws on nothing, which gives the classifier a no-contact class to separate the
real shapes from. The script prompts with the object name, so 'nothing' is what it will
tell the operator to put in.
